question: Which sacred sites are assigned to the right thigh, hip, and the places called māyāpū and kṣīraka?
premises: The verse continues the mapping of sacred sites onto body parts.
The right thigh and hip are treated as a directional starting point.
Māyāpū and kṣīraka are named as paired locations.
inference: Elāpura and the Eastern Bank are placed from the right thigh and hip, while Kuḍyākeśī and Sopāna are placed at Māyāpū and Kṣīraka.
uncertainties: The identification of māyāpū and kṣīraka as specific body locations is not explicit in the verse.
plain_english: From the right thigh and hip are Elāpura and the Eastern Bank; likewise, at Māyāpū and Kṣīraka are Kuḍyākeśī and Sopāna.
